{"metadata":{"description":"Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools for DeepSeek Harness with a Monaco editor and model-driven tool lifecycle.","id":"gh:1333068379","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-custom-tool","slug":"omdsh-dev/dsh-custom-tool","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools for DeepSeek Harness with a Monaco editor and model-dri"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"andboxed JavaScript tools for DeepSeek Harness with a Monaco editor and model-driven tool lifecycle."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-custom-tool"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Custom tools for the DeepSeek Harness: users author their own JavaScript tools in the settings UI wi"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"th a Monaco (VS Code) editor and TypeScript intellisense, and the model grows and prunes the same to"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"olset itself through `custom_tool_create` / `custom_tool_remove` / `custom_tools_list`. Every tool i"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"s durable, hot-registered, and written into the model prompt on the next step."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Problems it solves"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Users cannot extend their agent**: before this plugin, adding a capability meant shipping a harn"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ess package. Now a tool is a form in the settings UI — name, description, parameters, code — saved l"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ive and callable by the model immediately.
- **The model cannot grow itself**: `custom_tool_create` "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"lets the model persist tools mid-session (hot-registered, visible on its next step), with the same v"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"alidation gate the UI uses — the model cannot persist anything the settings UI would refuse.
- **Use"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"r-authored code runs in a restricted worker**: every call executes in a fresh worker thread inside a"},{"id":"p5s7","text":" `node:vm` realm with an explicit allowlist, Node Permission Model, and hard budgets. The worker rec"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"eives no inherited environment variables, filesystem access outside its configured scope, or child-p"},{"id":"p5s9","text":" environment variables, filesystem access outside its configured scope, or child-process capability."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Settings UI** (`Custom Tool` section, own nav glyph): list, create, edit, enable/disable, delete"},{"id":"p7s2","text":". Model-created and workspace-scoped tools are badged. Every string follows the harness locale (Chin"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ese / English) and switches with the language preference.
- **Monaco editor**: VS Code engine + Type"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"Script language service; `args` typed from the parameter schema, `env`/sandbox globals declared, com"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"pletions and diagnostics live. Editor and TS workers are bundled inline — the client bundle is a sin"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"gle file.
- **Durable store**: tools live in the `custom-tools` settings namespace (schema defaults,"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" composition base, user document — the ordinary settings layering). Edits apply live; restart restor"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"es them.
- **Live registration**: enabled tools register into `ctx.tools` the moment the settings wr"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"ite commits; disabled/removed tools unregister immediately. The harness assembles tool schemas into "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"the system prompt automatically.
- **Model self-service**: `custom_tool_create` (upsert by name), `c"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"ustom_tools_list`, and `custom_tool_remove` share the UI's validation gate and the ownership rules b"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"_tools_list`, and `custom_tool_remove` share the UI's validation gate and the ownership rules below."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Tool scopes and permission boundaries"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Every tool declares one of two execution scopes. The boundary is the core security contract of this "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ool declares one of two execution scopes. The boundary is the core security contract of this plugin:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| | `global` (default) | `workspace` |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Purpose | pure computation, external data, workflows | recurring file tasks inside the session wor"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"kspace |
| `fetch` (network) | per `allowNetwork` config | per `allowNetwork` config |
| `console`, "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"timers, `TextEncoder`, `URL`, … | yes | yes |
| `fs` capability | **no** | `readFile` / `writeFile` "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"/ `list`, confined to the session workspace root |
| `require` / `import` / `process` | never | neve"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"list`, confined to the session workspace root |
| `require` / `import` / `process` | never | never |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Confinement rules for the `workspace` scope**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- The root is the session workspace directory (the initiating agent's `cwd`), resolved at call time."},{"id":"p13s2","text":"
- Relative paths resolve from the root; absolute paths must stay inside it; any path that escapes t"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"he root is rejected with an explicit error.
- Outside a session (no initiator context) a workspace t"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ool fails with `no workspace root` rather than running without a boundary.
- Confinement is lexical "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"(`resolve` + prefix check). A symlink inside the workspace can still point out of it — workspace sco"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"pe is trusted code, not a sandbox against a malicious host. The liveness budgets below apply to both"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"usted code, not a sandbox against a malicious host. The liveness budgets below apply to both scopes."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Storage locations**"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Every tool also declares where it EXISTS:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- `location: 'global'` — stored in the shared settings namespace; available in every workspace until"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" removed.
- `location: 'workspace'` — stored in a per-workspace file under `<dsh home>/workspace-too"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ls/`, keyed by the canonical workspace root; visible only to sessions of that workspace (registered "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"into each matching agent's own tool scope)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The two dimensions combine freely: a global-location tool with workspace scope (a durable file task "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"the user keeps everywhere, like a PDF reader) runs its `fs` on whichever workspace calls it."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**Ownership and authorization rules for the model**"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- The model may create, list, and remove **model-created** tools (`source: model`).
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (mounts the host plugin) and `dsh.client` (serves the browse"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"r half at `/plugins/dsh-custom-tool/client.js`). `lib/` is committed, so the GitHub tarball installs"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" without a build step."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**Harness requirement**: the settings namespace is exposed to web configuration clients through the "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"`WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES` allowlist in `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts`; the string `'custo"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"m-tools'` must be present there (the upstream harness commit `d6ea05b5` adds it). Without it the UI "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"renders but saves are silently refused (`settings-not-exposed`)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Tool code contract"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The code field is the **body of an async function** `async (args, env) => value`:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Return** a JSON value (string, number, boolean, null, array, or plain object); `undefined` or a "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"non-JSON value fails the call.
- **Parameters**: object-rooted JSON Schema in the harness subset — `"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"type`, `properties`, `required`, `items`, `enum`, `const`, `oneOf`, `additionalProperties`, `descrip"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"tion`, `title`, `default`, `examples`.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- Custom tool names cannot shadow tools owned by other packages; a collision surfaces as a per-tool "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"registration failure in `custom_tools_list`.
- Workspace confinement is lexical, not symlink-proof ("},{"id":"p29s3","text":"see the scope table).
- No per-tool test-run button in the UI yet; tools are exercised through model"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" calls or a headless run."}],"truncated":true}
